# Bing

7 endpoints, all GET. Base URL `https://www.socialcrawl.dev`, auth header `x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY`.

**Credit costs:** 5 standard (1 credit), 2 advanced (5) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

## GET /v1/bing/images - 1 credit (standard)

Returns Bing Images results for a query, up to 35 a page, in the row shape of GET /v1/google/images: Bing's image id, the full-size image with its width and height, the thumbnail, the title and Bing's caption, the page the image sits on and the site. Filter by size (small, medium, large, wallpaper), type (photo, clipart, linedrawing, animatedgif, transparent), aspect (square, wide, tall), color (color, bw, or one of red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink, brown, black, gray, white), face (face or portrait), time_range (day, week, month or year) and license=creative_commons. market (for example en-GB) or country picks the Bing edition; when both are sent, market wins. Pass the returned cursor for the next page; a page leaves out any image an earlier page of the same walk served.

**Use when** you want to find images by size, type, colour, date or licence, or to compare what Bing and Google show for the same query.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Paging** cursor · ≈35/page (observed once); set with `limit` · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/35) x 1 credits

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - What to search for, up to 2,048 characters. · e.g. `red bicycle`
- `market` (optional, string) - Bing market, for example en-US, en-GB or de-DE.
- `country` (optional, string) - Two-letter country, used when no market is sent.
- `safe_search` (optional, enum: strict | moderate | off) - strict, moderate (default) or off.
- `time_range` (optional, enum: any | day | week | month | year) - any (default), day, week, month or year.
- `size` (optional, enum: small | medium | large | wallpaper) - small, medium, large or wallpaper.
- `type` (optional, enum: photo | clipart | linedrawing | animatedgif | transparent) - photo, clipart, linedrawing, animatedgif or transparent.
- `aspect` (optional, enum: square | wide | tall) - square, wide or tall.
- `color` (optional, enum: color | bw | red | orange | yellow | green | teal | blue | purple | pink | brown | black | gray | white) - One of color (in colour), bw (black and white), red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink, brown, black, gray, white (a dominant colour).
- `face` (optional, enum: face | portrait) - face (faces only) or portrait (head and shoulders).
- `license` (optional, enum: creative_commons) - creative_commons for Creative Commons images only.
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-35) - Images a page, 1 to 35 (default 35).
- `cursor` (optional, string) - The next_cursor from a previous page of the same search. Omit for the first page.
- **Shared controls** `max_pages` (1-50) → [walks](api-overview.md#search-filters-and-multi-page-walks); `max_items` (1-5000) · `max_credits` (1-100000) → [one-call walks](api-overview.md#get-more-in-one-call-max_items-max_credits-max_pages)

**Response** `MediaList` rows at `data.items[]` (inferred from a sample): {id string, position number, title string, image_url string, thumbnail_url string, width number, height number, thumbnail_width number, thumbnail_height number, page_url string, source string, description string}.

Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`, `data.walk`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/bing/images" \
  --data-urlencode "query=red bicycle" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/bing/rank - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns whether a domain or a URL path ranks on Bing for a search, its best position, and every matching result with its position, link, title and page, scanning up to 200 positions in one call.

**Use when** you want to track where a site ranks on Bing for a keyword, including positions search does not reach.
**Cost** cache 1800 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - The search to check, for example best running shoes. · e.g. `best running shoes`
- `url` (required) - The site to look for: a domain (example.com, matching its subdomains) or a URL with a path (example.com/blog, matching pages under it). · e.g. `runnersworld.com`
- `market` (optional, string) - Bing market, for example en-US, en-GB, de-DE or ja-JP (38 in all). Default en-US.
- `country` (optional, string) - Two-letter country, only when it should differ from the market's.
- `language` (optional, string) - Language code such as en or de, only when it should differ from the market's.
- `safe_search` (optional, enum: strict | moderate | off) - strict, moderate or off.
- `time_range` (optional, enum: any | day | week | month | year) - any, day, week, month or year: only pages published or updated within it.
- `device` (optional, enum: desktop | mobile) - desktop or mobile: which results page to read.
- `depth` (optional, integer, 1-200) - Organic positions to scan, 1 to 200. Default 100. One call at any depth.
- `all_matches` (optional, boolean) - true to scan the whole depth and report every matching position. Default false (stop at the first results page with a match).
- `include_subdomains` (optional, boolean) - false to count only the exact domain. Default true.

**Response** `Analytics` object at `data` (inferred from a sample): {query string, target string, found boolean, position number, depth number, depth_scanned number, end_of_results boolean}; `matches[]` {position number, url string, title string, page number}.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/bing/rank" \
  --data-urlencode "query=best running shoes" \
  --data-urlencode "url=runnersworld.com" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/bing/search - 1 credit (standard)

Returns Bing's first page of organic results for a search, each with its position, title, link, displayed address, domain, site name, snippet and date, plus Bing's estimated result count, a corrected query, related searches and People Also Ask questions where Bing shows them. `sponsored_results` is always null for now: the sponsored results cannot be read on every request, so they are not published. Bing's deeper pages are not served; GET /v1/bing/rank scans up to 200 positions for one domain.

**Use when** you want it for the top Bing results of a search. Only the first page is served, so chain rank to check deeper positions for a domain.
**Cost** cache 120 s · multi-source (billed once)
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.
**Paging** single page - Bing serves page 1 only: its page 2 failed 2 of 2 on the primary and repeated page 1 on the second step (measured 06/11/2026).

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - The search, for example best running shoes. · e.g. `best running shoes`
- `market` (optional, string) - Bing market, for example en-US, en-GB, de-DE or ja-JP (38 in all). Default en-US.
- `country` (optional, string) - Two-letter country, only when it should differ from the market's.
- `language` (optional, string) - Language code such as en or de, only when it should differ from the market's.
- `safe_search` (optional, enum: strict | moderate | off) - strict, moderate or off.
- `time_range` (optional, enum: any | day | week | month | year) - any, day, week, month or year: only pages published or updated within it.
- `device` (optional, enum: desktop | mobile) - desktop or mobile: which results page to read.
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-10) - Results to return, 1 to 10. Default 10.

**Response** `SearchResult` rows at `data.items[]` (inferred from a sample): {position number, title string, url string, displayed_url string, domain string, site_name string, snippet string, date string}.

Page-level: `data.corrected_query`, `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`, `data.people_also_ask`, `data.related_searches`, `data.sponsored_results`, `data.total_results`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/bing/search" \
  --data-urlencode "query=best running shoes" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/bing/shopping/product - 1 credit (standard)

Returns one Bing Shopping product on the canonical Product: its full title, description, rating out of 5 and review count (the floor of Bing's rounded label, kept in product.ext.bing.reviews_label) and images, with every store offering it in product.ext.bing.offers (seller, price, price as printed, currency, link, free shipping). product.price and product.seller are the lowest offer's. Identify the product by id, the product.id a GET /v1/bing/shopping/search row carries. A product Bing no longer has returns 404 and is not charged.

**Use when** you want to read a product in full and compare its offers across stores after finding it with the search.
**Cost** cache 900 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `id` (required) - The product's id as GET /v1/bing/shopping/search returns it in product.id. · e.g. `eyJ2IjoxLCJ1cmwiOiJodHRwczovL3d3dy5iaW5nLmNvbS9zaG9wL2VudGl0eWRldGFpbHM_`

**Response** `Product` object at `data`, `{ product }` ([full schema](schemas/Product.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `product.title` | Product title |
| `product.id` | Platform product ID… |
| `product.url` | Direct URL to the product page |
| `product.description` | Product description. |
| `product.image_urls` | Primary image URL, or an array of image URLs for products… |
| `product.reviews_count` | Number of written reviews. |

+6 more (types in the full schema): `product` {seller}; `product.ext` {bing}; `product.price` {currency, current}; `product.rating` {average, count}. Never filled: `product.availability`, `product.brand`, `product.price.original`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/bing/shopping/product" \
  --data-urlencode "id=eyJ2IjoxLCJ1cmwiOiJodHRwczovL3d3dy5iaW5nLmNvbS9zaG9wL2VudGl0eWRldGFpbHM_" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/bing/shopping/search - 1 credit (standard)

Returns Bing Shopping products for a query, about 36 a page, on the canonical Product: the product's id (Bing's product token, which GET /v1/bing/shopping/product takes), title (Bing cuts long titles short here; the product endpoint has the full one), the Bing Shopping link, the seller and price with its currency, the rating out of 5 and the review count, and thumbnails. Bing prints review counts rounded (10K+), so product.reviews_count is the floor and the label is kept in product.ext.bing.reviews_label, beside the price as printed (price_label). market (for example en-GB) or country picks the Bing edition (default US); when both are sent, market wins. Pass the returned cursor for the next page.

**Use when** you want to compare prices and sellers for a product, track a product's price, or find which stores Bing lists for a search.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.
**Paging** cursor · ≈36/page (observed once) · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/36) x 1 credits

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - The product to search for, up to 2,048 characters. · e.g. `wireless earbuds`
- `market` (optional, string) - Bing market, for example en-US, en-GB or de-DE.
- `country` (optional, string) - Two-letter country, used when no market is sent (default us).
- `cursor` (optional, string) - The next_cursor from a previous page of the same search. Omit for the first page.
- **Shared controls** `max_pages` (1-50) → [walks](api-overview.md#search-filters-and-multi-page-walks); `max_items` (1-5000) · `max_credits` (1-100000) → [one-call walks](api-overview.md#get-more-in-one-call-max_items-max_credits-max_pages)

**Response** `ProductList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ product }` ([full schema](schemas/ProductList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `product.title` | Product title |
| `product.id` | Platform product ID… |
| `product.url` | Direct URL to the product page |
| `product.image_urls` | Primary image URL, or an array of image URLs for products… |
| `product.reviews_count` | Number of written reviews. |
| `product.seller` | Name of the seller. |

+5 more (types in the full schema): `product.ext` {bing}; `product.price` {currency, current}; `product.rating` {average, count}. Never filled: `product.availability`, `product.brand`, `product.description`, `product.price.original`. Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`, `data.walk`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/bing/shopping/search" \
  --data-urlencode "query=wireless earbuds" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/bing/suggestions - 1 credit (standard)

Returns the completions Bing suggests for a partial query, each as `text`, with `link` (Bing's results page for it) and, when Bing shows an entity for the completion, its `title`, `description` and `thumbnail`. Those four are null when the page could not read them. Bing localises completions, so a market changes the list.

**Use when** you want to see how people finish a search, for keyword ideas or autocomplete.
**Cost** cache 120 s · multi-source (billed once)
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.
**Paging** single page - One results page per call; there is no next page (measured 06/11/2026).

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - A partial search, for example best running sh. · e.g. `best running sh`
- `market` (optional, string) - Bing market, for example en-US, en-GB, de-DE or ja-JP (38 in all). Default en-US.

**Response** `SearchResult` rows at `data.items[]` (inferred from a sample): {text string, link null, title null, description null, thumbnail null}.

Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/bing/suggestions" \
  --data-urlencode "query=best running sh" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/bing/videos - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns Bing Videos results with hosting site, channel, duration, age, view count and thumbnail.

**Use when** you want to find videos on a topic across hosting sites in one search.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.
**Paging** single page - One results page per call; there is no next page (measured 06/11/2026).

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - The search, for example nike ad. · e.g. `nike ad`
- `market` (optional, string) - Bing market, for example en-US, en-GB, de-DE or ja-JP (38 in all). Default en-US.
- `country` (optional, string) - Two-letter country, only when it should differ from the market's.
- `language` (optional, string) - Language code such as en or de, only when it should differ from the market's.
- `safe_search` (optional, enum: strict | moderate | off) - strict, moderate or off.
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-30) - Videos to return, 1 to 30. Default 30.

**Response** `SearchResult` rows at `data.items[]` (inferred from a sample): {position number, title string, url string, publisher string, channel string, duration string, age string, views string, thumbnail_url string}.

Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/bing/videos" \
  --data-urlencode "query=nike ad" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## Withdrawn endpoints (do not call)

These stay registered but return `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` today and never bill. A permanent withdrawal is not coming back - use the alternative named in the platform's other endpoints rather than retrying.

- `GET /v1/bing/news` - temporarily withdrawn while its data source is re-established. Returns `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` and never bills; check the changelog before retrying.
- `GET /v1/bing/place` - temporarily withdrawn while its data source is re-established. Returns `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` and never bills; check the changelog before retrying.
- `GET /v1/bing/places/search` - temporarily withdrawn while its data source is re-established. Returns `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` and never bills; check the changelog before retrying.
